agent_assessment: Implementation covers all 14 rollout checklist items from the plan. Core validation logic (plan_validate.go) correctly checks 13 mandatory sections with normalized fuzzy matching, plus additional required elements (prompt-manager, greenfield, restart, idea-specific checks). All 15 unit tests pass. Pre-finalization gate in research.go injects advisory gap report into finalize agent prompt. Post-finalization gate in workshop_save.go writes validation-report.json on mode=='finalize'. Queue blocking in queue_ops.go adds forceable BlockingReason when validation fails. API exposes plan_validation_json on single-item GET and dedicated /validation endpoint. UI components (ValidationBadge, ValidationReport) integrate into backlog-card and detail page. One notable gap: the list endpoint (handler_query.go:69) uses backlogToProto() instead of backlogToProtoWithValidation(), meaning planValidationJson will be empty in list responses. This affects the ValidationBadge on cards and client-side validation_status filtering in BacklogTab.tsx. However, the backend validation_status query parameter filter works correctly (reads from disk). Research items are properly excluded throughout.
notes: List endpoint (handler_query.go:69) uses backlogToProto() not backlogToProtoWithValidation() — planValidationJson is missing from list responses, so ValidationBadge on cards will always be empty and client-side validation filter in BacklogTab won't work. Backend query param filter still works since it reads from disk.
All 15 unit tests pass (validation logic, I/O, stale report refresh, fuzzy matching, gap formatting)
contains() helper used in tests is defined in batch_handler_test.go:465 (same package) — not a bug
No integration tests for pre/post-finalization gates, queue blocking, or /validation endpoint exist yet (plan called for them but only unit tests were implemented)

evidence.title: Pre-finalization gate integration (research.go)
evidence.description: Lines 299-312: After existing pre-finalization checks, loads plan.md via DeliverableForKind/LoadPlanContentByName, runs ValidatePlanCompleteness, formats gap report. Gap report injected into agent prompt at line 347-349. Skips research kind. Advisory only — does not block finalization. Matches plan spec exactly.

evidence.title: Post-finalization gate integration (workshop_save.go)
evidence.description: Lines 102-113: After saving finalize round, checks round.Mode=='finalize' && kind!=KindResearch, loads plan.md, validates, writes validation-report.json via WriteValidationReport. Logs pass/fail with section counts. Matches plan spec.

evidence.title: Queue blocking integration (queue_ops.go)
evidence.description: Lines 148-166: Loads validation report from disk, checks Passed field. If failed, constructs descriptive message with missing sections and warnings, appends forceable BlockingReason. Integrates cleanly with existing blocking flow. Matches plan spec.

evidence.title: API surface — /validation endpoint + proto field
evidence.description: handler.go:225 registers GET /api/v1/backlog/{kind}/{name}/validation. handler_query.go:116-154 implements GetValidation — always re-runs validation fresh, caches result. Single-item GET at line 107 uses backlogToProtoWithValidation which includes plan_validation_json. Proto field added as optional string plan_validation_json = 20.

evidence.title: List endpoint gap — planValidationJson missing from list responses
evidence.description: handler_query.go:69 uses backlogToProto() (not backlogToProtoWithValidation) for list items. This means planValidationJson is never populated in list responses. Impact: ValidationBadge on backlog cards will always render null. Client-side validation filter in BacklogTab.tsx won't match any items. Backend validation_status query param filter still works (reads from disk). This is a functional gap vs the plan spec which says 'API exposes plan_validation_json raw JSON string on BacklogItem GET and list'.

evidence.title: UI components — ValidationBadge and ValidationReport
evidence.description: validation-badge.tsx: Parses planValidationJson, renders green/yellow/red pill with icons (CheckCircle/AlertTriangle/XCircle). Follows CircuitBrokenBadge pattern. Returns null if no data. validation-report.tsx: Collapsible panel with ShieldCheck icon, shows sections present (green), missing (red), warnings (yellow), timestamp. Integrated in backlog-card.tsx:149 and BacklogDetailsPage.tsx:453,526.

evidence.title: UI filter — validation status chips in FilterBar
evidence.description: FilterBar.tsx adds VALIDATION_STATUSES (passed/failed/none) as filter chips. BacklogTab.tsx:51-62 implements client-side filtering on planValidationJson. types.ts adds ValidationStatusFilter type and validationStatus field to BacklogFilters. Note: client-side filter depends on planValidationJson being in list response (see e7 gap).
